31539-(R1865).s: The bill approves the Dutch Kingdom's withdrawal of reservations made when ratifying several international counter-terrorism conventions and protocols, including those on hostage-taking, internationally protected persons, nuclear material, airport violence and maritime and platform safety. It is a formal treaty-approval act with no new executive delegation of rule-making power.
31539-(R1865).j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the withdrawal of reservations by reference to the broader counter-terrorism measures and the aim of avoiding safe havens for terrorism suspects, without new delegated powers.
q: For the entire Kingdom, the reservation concerning Article 7 of the New York Convention of 14 December 1973 on the prevention and punishment of crimes against internationally protected persons, including diplomats, is approved as withdrawn.

Artikel 1 Voor het gehele Koninkrijk wordt goedgekeurd dat het voorbehoud, dat betrekking heeft op artikel 7 van het op 14 december 1973 te New York totstandgekomen Verdrag inzake de voorkoming en bestraffing van misdrijven tegen internationaal beschermde personen, met inbegrip van diplomaten ( Trb .

parties: Asks for concrete examples of how jurisdiction would work compared with the old situation under reservations, and for the timeline of implementing legislation in the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba.

They ask whether examples can be given of situations in which the Netherlands, despite a request and whether or not based on an extradition treaty, would not extradite and would assert jurisdiction itself?

Zij vragen of er voorbeelden kunnen worden gegeven van situaties waarin Nederland, ondanks een verzoek daartoe en al dan niet op basis van een uitleveringsverdrag, niet zou overgaan tot uitlevering en de rechtsmacht aan zich zou trekken?

Asks after how long the Netherlands would wait before prosecuting, whether other affected states would be consulted, and how the UN personnel treaty is covered since it is not listed in articles 1 to 5.
These members understand this choice, but cannot see where it can be found in the present proposal.
Deze leden begrijpen deze keuze, maar zien niet waar dit kan worden teruggevonden in het voorliggende voorstel.
Supports the bill but asks under what circumstances the prosecution service may decline prosecution and whether a full investigation is always required.
These members ask the government to explain further under what circumstances the public prosecution service should be able to refrain from prosecution.
Deze leden vragen de regering nader toe te lichten onder welke omstandigheden het openbaar ministerie van vervolging zou moeten kunnen afzien.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises that the government proceed with withdrawing reservations to five counter-terrorism treaties to establish unconditional secondary universal jurisdiction, but asks it to explain in the explanatory memorandum the consequences of the delayed Antillean implementing legislation and Aruba's hesitation. The government's reply expands the Kingdom-position paragraph, updates Aruba's position to agreement, and adopts the drafting remark.
concerns: Consequences of the absence of implementing legislation in the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba should be set out in the explanatory memorandum, weighing Kingdom and international legal order interests.
Paragraph 5 on the Kingdom position should be updated and clarified, including Aruba's current stance.
Redactional remark on paragraph 2.2 wording ('het feitelijk ontbreken van prioritaire rechtsmachtaanspraken').

31700-A.s: This bill formally establishes the 2009 budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund, setting spending, commitments and receipts in thousands of euros, and entering into force on 1 January 2009. The accompanying explanatory memorandum describes project budget changes, Kustwacht coordination, and related departmental budget items without delegating new rule-making powers.
q: The budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2009 is established.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2009 wordt vastgesteld.

32028-(R1889).s: The bill seeks parliamentary approval, for the entire Kingdom, of the Paris convention of 10 September 1998 on issuing an attestation de vita (proof of life) certificate, with annexes. The convention obliges parties to recognise attestations issued by diplomatic, consular or other authorised officials, and sets formal requirements, translation aids and identity checks.
q: Whereas the Convention on the issuing of an attestation de vita concluded in Paris on 10 September 1998, with annexes, requires the approval of the States General under Article 91(1) of the Constitution before the Kingdom can be bound by it.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de op 10 september 1998 te Parijs tot stand gekomen Overeenkomst betreffende de afgifte van een attestatie de vita, met bijlagen, ingevolge artikel 91, eerste lid, van de Grondwet de goedkeuring van de Staten-Generaal behoeft

parties: Asks why nationality checks cannot be part of the thorough identity verification and what abuse could follow from not carrying them out.
The CDA members ask why the nationality investigation cannot also be included in that thorough verification.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen waarom in het kader van die gedegen controle niet ook het nationaliteitsonderzoek kan worden meegenomen.
Asks whether notaries and other authorities issuing attestations are subject to government control to prevent fraud.
These members ask whether there is any control over this by the government of the country concerned to prevent possible fraud.
Deze leden vragen of hier enige controle op is vanuit de overheid van het desbetreffende land om mogelijke fraude te voorkomen.

32123-A.s: This bill formally establishes the 2010 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Infrastructure Fund, setting expenditure and receipts in thousands of euros and fixing the entry-into-force date. The accompanying explanatory extract describes budget flexibility, project changes, Kustwacht coordination and project timelines, without creating new delegated rule-making powers.
q: The budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2010 is established.
De begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2010 wordt vastgesteld.

32222-A.s: This bill amends the 2009 departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund, adjusting appropriations and receipts for Verkeer en Waterstaat programmes in line with the autumn budget review (Najaarsnota). It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 December 2009, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2009 is amended, as shown in the statement belonging to this act.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende staat.

32500-B.s: This bill fixes the 2011 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) in thousands of euros, together with the commitment amounts for the general grant, integration grants and decentralisation grants under the Financiële-verhoudingswet. It also sets the entry-into-force rules and includes an annex with the detailed budget tables and an explanatory memorandum extract on specific grants and their administration.
q: The budget statement of the municipal fund for the year 2011 belonging to this act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2011 wordt vastgesteld.

32565-XIV.s: The bill amends the 2010 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, with supplementary changes in expenditure and commitments across policy articles, including the Najaarsnota adjustments. It also sets transitional rules making the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation responsible for the budget from 14 October 2010 and governing accountability through the annual report.
32565-XIV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to higher compensation costs, appeals on subsidy schemes and customs controls against animal disease, without discussing any delegation of power.
q: For the year 2010, in addition to Article 51(1)(b) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation accounts for the policy pursued and operational management via the annual report of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality.

Voor het jaar 2010 geldt, in aanvulling op artikel 51, eerste lid, aanhef en onder b, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001, dat Onze Minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie verantwoording aflegt over het gevoerde beleid en de bedrijfsvoering aan de hand van het jaarverslag van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit.

32565-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2010 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, adjusting appropriations and receipts for the Najaarsnota in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date of the amendment and orders its publication in the Staatsblad.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2010
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2010

33000-F.s: This bill sets the 2012 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds) at EUR 9.7 million for expenditure, commitments and receipts, in thousands of euros. It takes effect on 1 January 2012 and includes a retroactivity clause for later publication.
q: The budget statement of the Animal Health Fund for the year 2012 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Diergezondheidsfonds voor het jaar 2012 wordt vastgesteld.

33400-B.s: The bill formally sets the 2013 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) at the level of 17,963,120 thousand euros, with commitment amounts for the general and additional grants and for integration and decentralisation grants. It also fixes the entry into force of the budget statute and takes effect retroactively to 1 January if published late.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financial Relations Act for the general grant and additional grants is set for grant year 2013 at € 15,358,690,000.

Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering c.a. en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2013 vastgesteld op € 15 358 690 000.

33446-(R1992).s: The bill is a Rijkswet approving the Kingdom's intention to withdraw from the 1979 Vienna Statute of the United Nations Industrial Development Organization, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad and is published across the Kingdom's official gazettes.
q: The intention to withdraw from the Vienna Statute of the UNIDO of 8 April 1979 requires approval of the States General under Article 91(1) of the Constitution before the Kingdom can be bound by it.

Het voornemen tot opzegging van het op 8 april 1979 te Wenen tot stand gekomen Statuut van de Organisatie der Verenigde Naties voor Industriële Ontwikkeling ingevolge artikel 91, eerste lid, van de Grondwet de goedkeuring van de Staten-Generaal behoeft

parties: Asks the government to explain its position on UNIDO, the effectiveness of the organisation and the expected effects of withdrawal, while supporting terminating treaties no longer relevant.
These members still have a number of questions for the government about the bill.
Deze leden hebben nog wel een aantal vragen aan de regering over het wetsvoorstel.
Has no further questions on the bill.
which gives them no reason to pose further questions.
dat hun geen aanleiding geeft tot het stellen van nadere vragen.
Asks about the consequences of withdrawal for UNIDO, the timing of its effect, the late informing of parliament, and the use of freed funds.
Can the government indicate what consequences the withdrawal has for UNIDO?
Kan de regering aangeven welke gevolgen de opzegging heeft voor UNIDO?

Argues that withdrawal of this consequence requires explicit approval of the States General and finds the government's reasons unconvincing, demanding fuller justification and explanation of late parliamentary information.
The D66 members are of the view that withdrawal of Dutch membership is of such a nature and consequence that it cannot take place without explicit approval of the States General.

De leden van de D66-fractie zijn van mening dat de opzegging van het Nederlandse lidmaatschap van dusdanige aard en consequentie is dat deze niet kan plaatsvinden zonder uitdrukkelijke goedkeuring van de Staten-Generaal.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the government's plan to withdraw from the UNIDO Statute needs clearer justification and consequences for UNIDO, and that Sint Maarten's position be addressed. It also advised submitting the withdrawal for explicit parliamentary approval (rijkswet) rather than tacit approval; the government's reply accepted the motivation and Sint Maarten changes but kept the tacit-approval procedure.
concerns: The withdrawal motivation was insufficient and needed clearer reasons and attention to consequences for UNIDO, which the government addressed in the explanatory note.

The position of Sint Maarten and its contribution obligations were not addressed; the government reports Sint Maarten has decided the withdrawal applies to it too and the explanatory note was adjusted.

The Council advised explicit parliamentary approval by rijkswet instead of tacit approval because parliament will likely want to discuss the consequences, but the government argued the tacit procedure remains appropriate.

34200-C.s: This Slotwet amends the 2014 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), setting the final commitment amounts for the general grant and integration and decentralisation grants and adjusting the appropriations by euro thousands. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
34200-C.j: The memorandum explains the budget difference of EUR 113,000 by pointing to the provisional uitkeringsfactor and differences between estimated and actual distribution criteria.
q: as long as the uitkeringsfactor 1 is not final, the amount of payments to the provinces may differ from what is stated in the budget
zolang de uitkeringsfactor 1 niet definitief is de omvang van betalingen aan de provincies kan afwijken ten opzichte van wat in de begroting vermeld staat

34210-B.s: The bill amends the 2015 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), reducing commitment and expenditure amounts by roughly 399 million euro and 378 million euro respectively, and fixes the 2015 commitment amounts for the general and integration grants. It takes effect from 1 June 2015 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget of expenditure and receipts of the municipal fund for the year 2015
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2015

34300-B.s: This bill fixes the 2016 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) at the stated amounts in thousands of euros, and sets the commitment amounts for the general grant, supplementary grants, integration grants and decentralisation grants for 2016. The explanatory memorandum covers municipal financial positions, the Article 12 status of municipalities, cost estimates and the status of earlier parliamentary commitments.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financial Relations Act for the general grant and supplementary grants is set for the 2016 grant year at € 15,419,045,000.

Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering c.a. en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2016 vastgesteld op € 15.419.045.000.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the 2016 municipal fund budget bill should not refer to a separate 'integratie-uitkering sociaal domein' because the Financiële-verhoudingswet and the implementing decree provide no basis for distinguishing it from other integration grants. The minister and state secretary replied that the separate mention was made only for the grant's size and importance, not to create a distinction, and the bill was adjusted accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling holds that no legal basis in the Fvw or its implementing rules allows distinguishing the social domain integration grant from other integration grants in the budget bill.

34725-XVI.s: This Slotwet bill amends the 2016 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and the budget statements of its agencies, bringing spending and commitments in line with realised figures. It is a purely budgetary adjustment with no delegation of rule-making power and no new executive powers.
q: We have decided and resolved that the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2016 is amended
Wij ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2016 wordt gewijzigd

34950-XVI.s: This Slotwet (final budget act) amends the 2017 departmental expenditure statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and the related agency budget statements, adjusting appropriations and commitments to realised spending. It sets the amendments in thousands of euros, takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2017 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.

Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2017 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35200-B.s: This Slotwet amends the 2018 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), setting final obligation and expenditure amounts for the general grant and integration and decentralisation grants. It records the realised figures against the budget and adjusts the commitment amounts under the Financiële-verhoudingswet.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the municipal fund for the year 2018
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2018

35210-A.s: This bill amends the 2019 departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund through a first supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across road, rail, regional, waterway and megaproject articles. It is a budgetary adjustment that does not itself delegate rule-making power to the executive.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2019
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2019

35300-A.s: This bill sets the 2020 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Infrastructuurfonds, fixing expenditure, commitments and receipts in thousands of euros, as required by the Comptabiliteitswet and the Wet Infrastructuurfonds. The explanatory memorandum excerpt covers project budgets, cash-flow shifts and the Kustwacht cost overview, with no new rule-making delegations to the executive.
q: The budget statement of the Infrastructuurfonds annexed to this law, referred to in article 2 of the Wet Infrastructuurfonds, is established for the year 2020.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds, genoemd in artikel 2 van de Wet Infrastructuurfonds, voor het jaar 2020 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no substantive remarks on the 2020 budget bill for the Infrastructure Fund and only offers drafting corrections in an annex, advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport accompanies the advice, noting that some budgets need amendment as set out in annexes, and the Afdeling's drafting suggestions concern citations of the Wet Infrastructuurfonds.
concerns: The Afdeling proposes editorial corrections to the considerans and article 1 referring to the Wet Infrastructuurfonds instead of the Stb. 1993, 319 citation.

35850-XIV.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget appropriations for the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, the NVWA agency's budget and operating accounts, and the Animal Health Fund, through a first supplementary budget totalling about 245 million euros in additional commitments and spending. It does not delegate rule-making powers or change institutional checks.
q: The commitment budget is increased by € 36.1 million.
Het verplichtingenbudget wordt met € 36,1 mln. verhoogd.

35850-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (first supplementary budget) and the agency budget statement for the RIVM, adjusting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes reallocations within the budget, such as moving funds for COVID-19 ICU training and transferring money between items, and updates the net healthcare expenditure and expenditure ceiling figures.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and of the agency budget statement of this ministry, both for the year 2021.
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van de begrotingsstaat inzake de agentschappen van dit ministerie, alle voor het jaar 2021.

36100-B.s: This slotwet amends the 2021 budget statement of the gemeentefonds (municipal fund), setting the final commitment amounts for the general grant and for integration and decentralisation grants, and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year. The bill itself contains no new delegations of rule-making power; it adjusts appropriations as set out in the attached budget tables.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financial Relations Act for the general grant and supplementary grants is set for grant year 2021 at € 29,238,583,000.

Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2021 vastgesteld op € 29.238.583.000.

36120-XVII.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2022 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII), changing commitment, expenditure and revenue amounts across policy articles. It also sets the budget unit in thousands of euros and makes the law effective the day after publication, retroactive to 1 June 2022.
q: the need has emerged for an amendment to the departmental budget statement of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) for the year 2022
de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (XVII), voor het jaar 2022

36200-A.s: This bill formally establishes the 2023 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Mobility Fund (Mobiliteitsfonds), setting expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros across transport infrastructure items. The explanatory memorandum extract concerns budget management of DBFM contracts, Kustwacht costs and reallocation of funds between modalities, with no meaningful grant of rule-making power.
q: The budget statement of the Mobility Fund belonging to this law, named in article 2 of the Mobility Fund Act, is established for the year 2023.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Mobiliteitsfonds, genoemd in artikel 2 van de Wet Mobiliteitsfonds, voor het jaar 2023 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on 12 September 2022 that it had no remarks on the 2023 budget bill for the Mobiliteitsfonds and recommended submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport of 19 September 2022 states that some budgets need amendments, which are set out in annexes, rather than addressing any substantive objections.

36374-(R2187).s: The bill amends the Dutch Constitution (Articles 85-87) to give the Eerste Kamer (Senate) the power to amend bills passed by the Tweede Kamer and send them back, with exceptions for constitutional revisions, two-thirds-majority laws, budget laws and related bills. It also adds a transitional additional article tied to a future change of the Kingdom Statute.
36374-(R2187).j: The memorandum justifies the change as strengthening legislative quality through a constitutionally legitimised procedure, arguing the Senate needs a constitutional instrument beyond accept-or-reject and that novelle practice is cumbersome.
q: The aim of this power is to enable the Eerste Kamer, through a swift, efficient and constitutionally legitimised procedure, to contribute to improving the quality of bills.

Het oogmerk waarmee deze bevoegdheid wordt voorgesteld, is de Eerste Kamer in staat te stellen via een snelle, efficiënte en grondwettelijk gelegitimeerde procedure bij te dragen aan het verbeteren van de kwaliteit van wetsvoorstellen.
p: Gives individual Senate members a right to propose amendments to bills before the Senate, with the Tweede Kamer retaining the final decision on each amendment.

parties: Asks the government to justify why the amendment-and-return power is a major change to the constitutional system and to clarify how it fits with the novelle procedure and the per-part voting and exempted laws.
These members would like to put a number of questions to the government on this matter.
Graag willen deze leden de regering daarover een aantal vragen stellen.

Asks whether the procedure legitimises existing practice or offers an alternative, what is meant by increasing Eerste Kamer influence, and whether the bill is meant to curb other Eerste Kamer instruments.
These members ask whether the proposed procedure is intended to give constitutional legitimacy to the established practice or to offer a constitutional alternative to it.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de voorgestelde procedure bedoeld is om de gegroeide praktijk van een grondwettelijke legitimatie te voorzien of om een grondwettelijk alternatief te bieden voor de gegroeide praktijk.

Supports a return power in principle but questions whether it makes the Eerste Kamer more politically neutral, whether the Tweede Kamer would accept amendments on politically sensitive bills, and the vague exemption for budget-related bills.
These members are in favour of a return power for the Eerste Kamer, as is also apparent from the relevant passage in the PvdA election programme.
Deze leden zijn voorstander van een terugzendrecht voor de Eerste Kamer, zoals ook mag blijken uit desbetreffende passage in het verkiezingsprogramma van de PvdA.

Sees the return power as an interesting addition, asks for a fuller account of how it relates to the other two Eerste Kamer reforms, for concrete examples of the scope of Tweede Kamer amendment power, and for justification of not returning bills to the Eerste Kamer after Tweede Kamer agreement.
These members regard the return power for the Eerste Kamer, alongside its ability to accept or reject a bill, as an interesting addition.
Deze leden vinden het instrument van het terugzendrecht voor de Eerste Kamer, naast haar mogelijkheden om een wetsvoorstel te aanvaarden of te verwerpen, een interessante toevoeging.

Questions the government's claim that the bicameral design no longer fits, asks whether the problem is structural enough to make the constitutional change necessary and proportionate, and asks about workload, support and the absence of a time limit.
These members ask for further justification of the structural character of the problem and the extent to which there is a problematic view of the Eerste Kamer's role.
Deze leden vragen een nadere onderbouwing van het structurele karakter en in hoeverre er sprake is van een problematische rolopvatting.

Doubts the bill is needed and warns the remedy may be worse than the problem; notes the bill sets no limit tying amendments to legislative quality, leaving room for politically motivated changes, and fears role blurring and rambling practice.
The proposal therefore also creates scope for making changes that are more politically motivated.
Het voorstel biedt daarmee ook gelegenheid voor het aanbrengen van wijzigingen die meer politiek zijn ingegeven.

Values attention to the Eerste Kamer but argues the related constitutional reforms must be assessed together, demands a fuller justification of necessity and proportionality, and flags risks of informal deal-making, politicisation and weaker transparency, as well as the need for legislative drafting support.

This member invites the government to explain what end-state it envisages in the trias politica with the three ongoing constitutional amendments affecting the Eerste Kamer and the introduction of constitutional review.

Dit lid nodigt de regering te motiveren welk eindbeeld het in de trias politica voor ogen heeft met de drie lopende grondwetswijzigingen die de Eerste Kamer raken en de invoering van constitutionele toetsing.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised in 2021 against submitting the bill granting the Eerste Kamer a right to amend and return bills to the Tweede Kamer unless revised, questioning the problem analysis, effectiveness, the retained veto, the time limits, and the Tweede Kamer's scope to amend. The government's nader rapport of 2023 accepted several points, dropped the fixed time limit, narrowed the Tweede Kamer's powers, and explained its choices but did not adopt the Afdeling's call for deeper motivation of the problem and effectiveness.
concerns: The Afdeling doubted that the problem was sufficiently demonstrated and that the amendment-and-return right would effectively reduce political manifestation or novelles; the government rebutted but added clarifications.

The Afdeling found the constitutional change to a core element of the bicameral system requires deeper justification, and alternatives insufficiently weighed; the government explained alternatives but did not deepen the problem analysis.

The Afdeling asked to address coherence with other proposals on the Eerste Kamer (election method, second reading of constitutional revisions); the government clarified the relationship in the memorie van toelichting.
The fixed two-month time limit for the Eerste Kamer to decide on amendment was considered too short for complex bills; the government removed the time limit.

The scope of the Tweede Kamer's power to amend Eerste Kamer amendments was insufficiently delimited and could create inconsistent texts; the government narrowed it to accepting or rejecting amendments.

The role of the government and other actors in the procedure after return was insufficiently addressed; the government clarified that only the Eerste Kamer may amend and that advice requests remain possible.
Constitutional text of Article 85 and the rijkswet procedure needed technical adjustment to make the amendment right workable, including exceptions for budget-related bills.

36435-XIV.s: This supplementary budget bill amends the 2023 budget statements of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality and of the Animal Health Fund, in thousands of euros. It sets an effective date of 19 September 2023 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
36435-XIV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes with additional funding needs for enforcement, implementation of the common agricultural policy and related programmes, without delegating new powers.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (XIV) and of the budget statement of the Animal Health Fund, both for the year 2023
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (XIV) en van de begrotingsstaat van het Diergezondheidsfonds, alle voor het jaar 2023

36435-XVI.s: This supplementary budget bill amends the 2023 departmental expenditure statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts in amounts of thousands of euros. It is retroactive to 19 September 2023 and mainly reallocates budget across policy articles without changing statutory rules.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport for the year 2023
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport voor het jaar 2023
